description: This file defines the Hyperlink class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It encapsulates properties and methods for creating and managing hyperlinks in spreadsheet cells, including URL, tooltip, type checking, and hash code generation.

classes.name: Hyperlink
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink in a spreadsheet cell, managing URL, tooltip, internal/external link type, and generating a hash code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Hyperlink object with optional URL and tooltip.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the hyperlink.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the hyperlink.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip text for the hyperlink.

methods.name: setTooltip
methods.description: Sets the tooltip text for the hyperlink.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if the hyperlink points to another worksheet internally.

methods.name: getTypeHyperlink
methods.description: Returns 'External' if the URL is outside the sheet, else an empty string.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the hyperlink object.
